title: Upstream crosslink observation: swarm docs describe H2 '## Phase:' headers; parser only recognizes H3 '### Phase N:' under Requirements

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DETAIL (crosslink @ 6b4f736f): docs_src/guides/swarm.qmd:265-277 documents H2 '## Phase:' / '## Layer:' headers as the explicit-phasing mechanism, but the parser consumed by swarm init (design_doc.rs:159-165, via init.rs:18) recognizes only H3 '### Layer N:' / '### Phase N:' INSIDE the '## Requirements' section; an H2 '## Phase:' lands in unknown_sections and produces no phase grouping. Trust the code: H3-under-Requirements with (parallel)/(sequential) hints is what works. Doc fix or parser extension — either closes it.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).
